Metadata.Title: S3 static-hosting bucket - private origin, CloudFront OAC read-only access
Metadata.RiskLevel: LEVEL 3 (High) assigned by docs/TODO.md; docs/AI_GUIDELINES.md risk matrix classifies AWS infrastructure as LEVEL 4 (Critical) - handled as LEVEL 4: Dev + Tech Lead review, Free Tier + Budget Alert check
Metadata.ThreatModel: Bucket static-hosting nao de 'Principal: *' hoac public-read se bi bot quet va bi dung lam pha phat tan malware / dot tien CDN trong vai gio. Vi vay bucket nay private 100%: 4/4 Block Public Access bat, ACL tat (BucketOwnerEnforced), chi CloudFront OAC duoc phep s3:GetObject. Khong co READ cong khai, khong co WRITE tu Internet, khong bat S3 website endpoint (OAC khong hoat dong voi website endpoint).

HowToApply.WhyEnvelope: This file is an audit envelope (Metadata + PolicyDocument + guards), not a bare policy document, so that traceability and forbidden examples live next to the policy. S3 only accepts a bare policy document -> extract PolicyDocument first (section 5.3 of s3_setup.md).
HowToApply.ExtractAndApply: python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('infra/aws/s3_bucket_policy.json',encoding='utf-8'));json.dump(d['PolicyDocument'],open('applied.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2)" && aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --policy file://applied.json
HowToApply.Verify: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --query Policy --output text

BucketIdentity.WebsiteEndpoint: NOT ENABLED - OAC only signs requests to the S3 REST endpoint; the website endpoint cannot be used behind OAC (AWS CloudFront Developer Guide: 'If your origin is an Amazon S3 bucket configured as a website endpoint ... you can't use OAC')

DefaultEncryption.Note: SSE-S3 is free and covers every object; no KMS CMK -> no KMS request charges.

CloudFrontOriginAccessControl.Name: fpl-frontend-oac
CloudFrontOriginAccessControl.AttachedToDistribution: NO - attached by P3-Q01 when the distribution is created (Origin.OriginAccessControlId)

BucketIdentity.CostEnvelope: S3 Standard Free Tier: 5 GB storage + 20,000 GET + 2,000 PUT/month. Frontend build is a few MB -> effectively $0.00.

PolicyDocumentDeferredStatement_P3Q01.Why: The strictest form pins AWS:SourceArn to one distribution. A distribution does not exist yet in P2-Q04 (creating it is P3-Q01), and an ARN that does not exist would make the policy useless/incorrect. P2-Q04 therefore pins the account (AWS:SourceAccount) and P3-Q01 MUST tighten it to AWS:SourceArn.
PolicyDocumentDeferredStatement_P3Q01.ApplyWhen: P3-Q01 (AWS CloudFront distribution) - replace statement Sid 'AllowCloudFrontOACReadOnly' with the statement below
PolicyDocumentDeferredStatement_P3Q01.AcceptanceAfterSwap: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --query Policy --output text | grep -c 'distribution/'  # must print 1

ForbiddenPolicyExamples_DO_NOT_APPLY.Why: Cho phep ca the gioi doc bucket (chinh sach 'static website' co dien). Vi pham Acceptance Criteria (phai qua CloudFront OAC) va se bi BlockPublicPolicy tu choi (AccessDenied) - 2 lop chan.

Service principal CloudFront nhung KHONG co Condition -> bat ky tai khoan AWS nao tao distribution tro ve bucket nay deu doc duoc (confused deputy). Phai luon co AWS:SourceAccount (P2-Q04) hoac AWS:SourceArn (P3-Q01).
Cap s3:* cho CloudFront -> CDN co the ghi/xoa object neu OAC bi loi dung. Chi duoc cap dung s3:GetObject.
Cho phep ListBucket cong khai -> lo toan bo danh sach file build (enumeration) va vo hieu hoa y do 'private origin'.
Bao ve bang aws:Referer - header do client tu gui, gia mao trong 1 dong curl. Khong phai co che xac thuc.

ForbiddenPrincipals: any principal without a CloudFront condition
AuditCommands: aws s3api get-bucket-policy-status --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --output json   # IsPublic must be false
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --output json            # no URI=AllUsers / AuthenticatedUsers grant
aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket fpl-lineup-frontend-prod --query Policy --output text
ComplianceGuards.ForbiddenCidrsNotApplicable: S3 is not VPC-scoped; network allow-lists cannot protect the bucket. Access control is IAM/bucket-policy + OAC only - do not mistake a Security Group for bucket protection.

VerificationMatrix.V6_OACExists: aws cloudfront get-origin-access-control --id E2IX1YDEAHD87E  ->  sigv4 / always / s3
